name: Prodiseum – Product Filters & Variation Swatches for WooCommerce
author: prodiseum

sections.description:
Prodiseum Product Filters & Variation Swatches combines WooCommerce AJAX product filters with color swatches, size options and visual variation selectors in one storefront workflow.

The free edition includes the essentials needed for a practical storefront:

  • AJAX product filtering.
  • Product categories and subcategories.
  • Global WooCommerce attributes.
  • Product tags.
  • Common brand taxonomies when available.
  • Price range filtering.
  • Stock / availability filtering.
  • Solid color swatches.
  • Size and attribute buttons.
  • Active filter chips and reset controls.
  • Responsive mobile filter drawer.
  • Visual variation selectors on single-product pages.
  • [quaerium_filter] shortcode.
  • Elementor filter widget.
  • Compatibility with WooCommerce product archives and Elementor Loop Grid / Current Query, including selected or automatically recognized catalog pages.
  • English-language interface and source strings.

Quaerium Free applies filters automatically when a shopper selects categories, attributes, swatches, tags, availability or a price range. Both standard WooCommerce grids and Elementor Loop Grid are updated without needing a submit button.

Quaerium PRO

Quaerium PRO is a separate premium plugin for stores that need more adaptive catalog behavior. It adds features such as dynamic option counts, contextual zero-result handling, category-specific filter sets, custom filter ordering, horizontal layouts, advanced swatches, advanced product-option handling, category presets for catalog pages and additional optimization controls.

The Free plugin does not contain locked premium functionality. You can compare editions from Prodiseum > Quaerium > Free vs PRO.

More information: https://prodiseum.com/quaerium
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install Prodiseum – Product Filters & Variation Swatches from Plugins > Add New, or upload the plugin ZIP.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Open Prodiseum > Quaerium.
  5. Review the detected filters and swatch presentation.
  6. Add the Quaerium Product Filters Elementor widget or [quaerium_filter] next to a WooCommerce archive or Elementor product Loop Grid. When using a regular WordPress page, it can also be selected in Elementor catalogs.
sections.faq:
Does the Free edition use AJAX?

Yes. Standard WooCommerce archives use AJAX. Elementor Loop Grid is updated from the rendered catalog page without replacing custom Elementor product cards with WooCommerce template markup.

Does it include variation swatches?

Yes. Quaerium Free can render solid colors as swatches and other variation attributes as buttons on product pages.

Can I filter by product attributes?

Yes. Global WooCommerce attributes are detected automatically and can be displayed as checkboxes, buttons or solid color swatches.

Does it work with Elementor?

The Free edition includes the filter widget and supports WooCommerce archives, Elementor Archive Products and Elementor Loop Grid with Current Query on product archives or catalog pages. When the filter widget is present on a regular WordPress page, Quaerium automatically rebuilds its product query. If Elementor renders the grid before the filter widget, select the page in Prodiseum > Quaerium > Elementor catalogs. The Loop Grid keeps its Elementor product-card design when filters change.

Is the Free edition just a trial?

No. Its included features remain available without a time limit or premium license. Quaerium PRO is a separate plugin with additional functionality.

Where can I compare Free and PRO?

Open Prodiseum > Quaerium > Free vs PRO in WordPress, or visit https://prodiseum.com/quaerium.
sections.changelog:
1.0.9

  • Moved the settings tab JavaScript into an enqueued script, loaded only on the Quaerium settings screen.
  • Updated plugin-specific PHP declarations, AJAX actions, front-end script data and stored option names to use a unique prefix.
  • Preserved existing Free settings and swatch colors through a read-only legacy migration.
  • Scoped dependency and edition-conflict notices to the Plugins screen.
  • Preserved automatic AJAX filtering and Elementor Loop Grid / Current Query compatibility.

1.0.8

  • Fixed Elementor Loop Grid filtering by passing the actual enabled status and selector from PHP to the front-end JavaScript, as Quaerium PRO does.
  • Restored automatic AJAX filtering immediately after selection changes, including attributes, color swatches, tags, price and stock filters.
  • Removed the unnecessary Show products button and retained Clear all.
  • Preserved the Elementor card design and the existing fallback for pages where a full-page update is required.
  • Free release contains only the original English interface and an untranslated message catalog template.

1.0.7

  • Restored the actual Quaerium PRO 0.8.10 Elementor Current Query and catalog-page handling, rather than limiting it to WooCommerce archives.
  • Detects pages that render a Quaerium filter widget and supports explicit catalog-page selection when Elementor renders the product Loop Grid first.
  • Uses the PRO Elementor Loop Grid HTML replacement flow for filtered results, preserving custom Elementor product cards.
  • Preserves WooCommerce product visibility, taxonomy context, pagination and selected filters.
  • Free package distributed without account or licensing components and without bundled language translations.

1.0.6

  • Restored the proven Elementor Loop Grid / Current Query product-archive initialization used in Quaerium PRO 0.8.10, including pre-render Query ID binding.
  • Fixed empty/singular inherited Elementor queries on WooCommerce shop archives and preserved product taxonomy context and catalog visibility constraints.
  • Retained full-page URL filtering for Elementor Loop Grid in Free, preserving custom Elementor product-card layouts. Standard WooCommerce archives continue using AJAX.

1.0.5

  • Added basic Elementor Loop Grid / Current Query support on WooCommerce product archives using URL-based filtering and full-page updates, preserving Elementor product-card layouts.
  • Ensured the inherited Elementor archive query targets WooCommerce products and carries selected product filters without duplicating constraints.
  • Standard WooCommerce and Elementor Archive Products AJAX behavior is unchanged.

1.0.4

  • Documented required WooCommerce AJAX taxonomy and product-meta queries for static code analysis, with no change to filtering behavior.

1.0.3

  • Removed bundled Spanish PO/MO translations; the Free package is distributed with English source strings only.
  • Retained the untranslated English POT message template for WordPress internationalization.
  • Removed the unused custom locale-file loader.

1.0.2

  • Removed the bundled third-party account and licensing SDK from the Free edition.
  • Removed its initialization and unused admin-menu cleanup code.
  • Free filtering, swatches, and the existing Free vs PRO comparison remain available without an account.

1.0.1

  • Prepared public Prodiseum name, text domain and directory identity for WordPress.org.
  • Improved repository search terms and Free feature description.
  • Fixed pagination controls appearing after AJAX filtering and removed inactive default price constraints.
  • Hardened price-input handling and kept native variation dropdowns accessible if the JavaScript swatches do not initialize.

1.0.0

  • Initial WordPress.org Free release.
  • Added AJAX filtering for categories, attributes, tags, brands, price and stock.
  • Added vertical filters, mobile drawer, active filter chips and reset controls.
  • Added solid color swatches and attribute buttons.
  • Added visual variation selectors on WooCommerce product pages.
  • Added shortcode and Elementor filter widget.
  • Added the shared Prodiseum admin hub and a dedicated Free vs PRO comparison page.
  • Added English source strings and a gettext message template.
